name: North Carolina

flag.description: A blue vertical band at the hoist with a white star between gold letters "N" and "C", and gold scrolls above and below bearing the dates "May 20th 1775" and "April 12th 1776"; the fly has two equal horizontal bands of red over white.
flag.symbolism: The two dates mark the Mecklenburg Declaration of Independence and the Halifax Resolves, early steps towards independence.

hook: North Carolina is Texas turned the other way up: red over white, with "N★C" and two dates on the blue band.
trivia: The Halifax Resolves of 12 April 1776 made North Carolina the first colony to instruct its delegates to vote for independence.
The authenticity of the Mecklenburg Declaration of 20 May 1775 is disputed by historians, yet its date remains on the flag.
